key_insight: IECG links ECG diagnostic predictions to localized waveform evidence without requiring manually annotated abnormal regions.
clinical_relevance: Highlighting waveform regions associated with predictions could make AI-assisted ECG interpretation easier to scrutinize, though clinical benefit is not established in the abstract.
method: Derives abnormality heatmap pseudo-labels from established ECG clinical knowledge.
Guides CLS-token attention with a KL-divergence loss alongside ECG–text alignment and report captioning objectives.
Aggregates features from attention-guided regions to support diagnostic classification.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports state-of-the-art abnormal-region localization and strong classification performance, but provides no dataset details or numerical results.
watch_item: Reliance on clinical-prior-derived pseudo-labels warrants checking whether highlighted regions remain reliable across diverse ECG patterns and clinical settings.
paper_title: IECG: Weakly-Supervised Interpretability-Enhancing Foundation Model for Electrocardiogram
